independence: The source editor wrote all seventeen independent Cook solutions in exercise-requirements.json before opening curriculum/proposals/unit08/author-only-models.json. The separate public composition was likewise translated before author models were opened.

findings.issue: Author models used ðā wæter; the actual selected productive accusative plural waeter-acc-pl is wæteru.
findings.resolution: Source editor requested ðā wæteru; design editor confirmed both models corrected.

findings.issue: Source editor's independent trēow variant did not match selected productive treo-nom-sg trēo.
findings.resolution: Source editor aligned its comparison model to the existing selected trēo. The author model already used it.

findings.issue: Placement in the sea required an attested construction, not an assumed motion-to-accusative rule.
findings.resolution: Cook125 printedline15 has gesętte hīe on ðǣre heofonan, with dative location. The bounded model Gesęte ðone fisc on ðǣm sǣ is accepted with the exact supplied command and local placement support.

findings.issue: The control sense of on was not taught by spatial on or under.
findings.resolution: Cook127 printedline9 attests habbað on ēowrum gewealde. The singular command/possessive and spirits object are a declared adaptation of that frame. Contract must explicitly teach the new bounded control construction.

findings.issue: Actual baseline lacks productive scīnan subjunctive systems and all geblētsian imperative cells.
findings.resolution: Root, grammar and design editors notified. Required complete systems are explicit in exercise-requirements.json. Model forms are linguistically plausible but are not prior teaching.

accepted_model_alternatives: I.8.10 author nīetenu and source editor dēor both express animals and use prior productive plural morphology with geręstan + reflexive hīe.

I.8.16 author cweðe and source editor sęcge both express say with prior productive finite forms. The author chooses plural geblētsiað; singular geblētsa is also valid when the unstated addressee is singular.
I.8.17 author gescēope and source editor geworhtest both keep the required second-person singular agreement. Creation of life permits the explicitly taught create/make senses.
Unqualified your in I.8.1 and fish in I.8.13 permit the alternative numbers recorded in the requirement audit; the selected model is not the only valid language.
